question:
Fill in the blank with an appropriate option.

He could feel every ______ and artery in his body.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2' **i.e. **'Vein'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• He could feel every vein and artery in his body.
 
• The reason **this is correct **is because veins and arteries are the blood vessels that form the circulatory system in the body.
